hero.headline: Solutions that work in the real world.
hero.tagline: AI Enabler · AI Solution Specialist · Change & Adoption
hero.intro: AI is more than a chat. It can unlock knowledge, act as an advisor, carry processes and take work off your hands. It just needs someone who separates value from theater and builds the bridges between what is possible and everyday work.
hero.step1Text: Where work gets stuck and which method holds up over time.
hero.step2Text: Tool, skill or agent framework. Built, not just recommended.
hero.step3Text: Activating and training people, otherwise it does not hold.
projects.heading: My projects and proof
projects.subheading: The right solution for every problem.
projects.intro: What I own, guide and build has to hold up and not just work. My AI expertise does not stop at prompting. It shows in what has come out of it and in what still can.
skills.heading: Not a classic developer
skills.intro: 20 years in tech, marketing, communications, support and operations, everywhere I had the same reflex: I find the places where things get stuck. With AI, that has turned into new value. I build solutions in a way that people understand and enjoy using. Whether change lands is not decided by the technology, but by noticeable improvement and a good story.
services.heading: My mindset and approach
services.subheading: Where change meets enabler and builder.
services.intro: I measure success by impact and acceptance, not by how much AI went into it. I can see where an AI framework helps, where an automated process takes load off, and where a lean browser app is enough.
about.heading: Behind ai-mods is Chris
about.subheading: Cross-expertise from 20+ years on the job.
about.p1: My journey runs from tech and GIS through marketing & communications to service and operational team leadership with 16 people. The curious nerd who teaches himself things has always been on board. And when it matters, I can do suit and tie, too. Today I combine all of that with AI. As a strategist, toolmaker and enabler with a can-do mentality.
